edit.description: fold gitPath over the job-dir pathspec before add/status/commit/ls-files/rm

summary: jobNew/jobRm compose their .flume/jobs/<name> pathspec with node:path and skip gitPath, the engine's one host-to-git alphabet rule

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

acceptance: Every pathspec src/job.ts hands git is folded through gitPath (src/paths.ts); no node:path-composed pathspec remains in the file.
pins: jobNew's seed commit names its job dir in git's forward-slash alphabet
notes: win32-only under-match: join yields `.flume\jobs\<name>`, matching nothing under either dialect (literal reads `\` as a byte, default as a wildmatch escape), so `job rm` logs "no tracked harness" and then rm -rf's the dir. No posix-observable pre-fix failure, so this ships under engineering.md's named exception in *A fix ships the test that would have caught it* - say so in the commit body. validateJobName already bars a separator in <name>, so join is the sole source.
